description: Get the full detail for a single UK Contracts Finder notice by the `id` returned by search_notices or recent_notices. Returns the complete (untruncated) description, buyer, contract value, awarded supplier, CPV classification, region, tender period and contact where published. Accepts either id form — search_notices returns a bare GUID and recent_notices an OCDS release id ("{guid}-{seq}"); they are separate id spaces on separate endpoints, and this tool routes to the right one for you. Keyless.

id.description: The `id` from a search_notices result (a bare GUID, e.g. "5295555c-7556-4726-bd59-7895f51a3c3a") or from recent_notices (an OCDS release id, e.g. "a42239ac-faef-4245-ad0f-16b3a787675b-901561"). Either works.
